stream: Returns the completion in a stream rather than waiting for the completion to finish and returning it all at once. There is no support for JSON mode when streaming is enabled.
jsonMode: Forces the model to output a JSON object. There is no support for streaming when JSON mode is enabled.
temperature: Controls randomness: lowering results in less random completions. As the temperature approaches zero, the model will become deterministic and repetitive.
maxCompletionTokens: The model can generate up to 65536 tokens, and can use up to 131072 tokens shared between prompt and completion.
reasoning: Select the level of reasoning effort. Higher levels may use more tokens and provide more thorough reasoning in the model's response.

tools.browserSearch: If enabled, the model will be able to search the web.
tools.codeExecution: If enabled, the model will be able to execute code.

moderation: When this feature is on, we will first call llamaguard to check for moderation.
topP: Controls diversity via nucleus sampling: 0.5 means half of all likelihood-weighted options are considered.
seed: Seed used for sampling. Groq attempts to return the same response to the same request with an identical seed. If empty, a random seed is used.
stopSequence: A stop sequence is a predefined or user-specified text string that signals an AI to stop generating content, ensuring its responses remain focused and concise. Examples include punctuation marks and markers like "[end]".
template: Preview the chat request with its template applied and individual tokens.
